template: In the Ghost admin, open the post titled '{{v1}}' (do NOT touch any post whose title starts with 'Seed:') and publish it: click Publish, then confirm in the publish flow dialog (choose 'Publish' / continue, NOT 'Schedule' — the publish date {{v3}} is in the past so it should publish immediately, not schedule). Complete the whole confirmation flow until the post is actually published. Then verify: the post status shows Published (not Draft, not Scheduled), and open the post's settings panel to confirm the tag is still exactly '{{v4}}' (one tag only), the excerpt still reads '{{v5}}', the publish date still shows {{v3}}, and report the URL slug exactly as shown. Also verify the post is publicly visible by opening the post's public URL in a new tab and reporting that the page loads with the title and body paragraph. Report the status, tag, excerpt, publish date, slug, and what the public page showed.

reportTemplate.summary: Published the draft "{{v1}}" (no Seed: post touched) via Publish → the flow offered "Right now" (immediate, not Schedule) → "Continue, final review →" → "Publish post, right now". Ghost confirmed "Boom! It's out there. That's 4 posts published." and the post now shows status Published (not Draft/Scheduled) both in the editor (status link "Published View post", an Unpublish button in place of Publish) and in the Published posts list ("By Bench Admin in {{v4}} - 01 Sep 2026 - Published"). Re-opened its settings panel: exactly one tag, "{{v4}}" (chip read back literally, no "Bench Newsletter"), Excerpt still "{{v5}}", publish date still {{v3}} (time 02:02 UTC), slug "{{v2}}-bench-post". The public URL http://127.0.0.1:8099/{{v2}}-bench-post/ loads with document title and H1 "{{v1}}" and the body paragraph "This bench post was created by run {{v2}}." (the excerpt appears above it as the post card text), tagged {{v4}}, dated 01 Sep 2026.
